input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin envelope with schema_version toolbox-noaa-co2-ch4-growth-pair-input-r1 containing complete version-0.1.0 CO2, CH4 and N2O comparator outputs from fixed NOAA GML page/raw surfaces; all request the same inclusive year range and N2O starts no earlier than 2001.
required_outputs: Same-year separate NOAA GML CO2 (ppm), CH4 (ppb) and N2O (ppb) source-surface comparison rows with per-gas statuses; no cross-gas arithmetic or simultaneity claim.
Six fixed-source receipts, retrieval timestamps, response digests, upstream request counts, comparator-output digests and combined capture-time span.
